newsitem.title: FRANCE: Arthuis says euro will help growth, jobs.
newsitem.headline: Arthuis says euro will help growth, jobs.

text.p: French finance minister Jean Arthuis said on Saturday that the euro single currency will allow for monetary stability within the European Union, which in turn will help economic growth and jobs.
"I am convinced that the euro will provide the conditions for confidence and thus investment, and thus growth and employment," Arthuis said.
He was speaking before the national council of Force Democrate, the second largest party within the UDF (Union pour la Democratie Francaise) liberal centre-right alliance.

Arthuis said two thirds of France's exports went to its partners in the European Union and the euro would shelter over 90 percent of the market sector gross domestic product from exchange rates fluctuations.
Arthuis also repeated that he saw the euro becoming a major world reserve currency, allowing for monetary stability.

"Because we will have a single currency at European level, this currency will be one of the major world currency, one of the major reserve currency, and we will finally have the conditions for monetary stability," he said.
